title: Game of Thrones
facts: The series is based on George R. R. Martin's novels, A Song of Ice and Fire.
David Benioff and D. B. Weiss created the series.
Game of Thrones ran on HBO from April 17, 2011 to May 19, 2019.
The series has 73 episodes across eight seasons.
Game of Thrones won 59 Primetime Emmy Awards, a record for a drama series.
Peter Dinklage won four Emmy Awards for playing Tyrion Lannister.
Filming locations included Northern Ireland, Croatia, Iceland, and Spain.
The old city of Dubrovnik in Croatia stands in for King's Landing in most seasons.
The original pilot never aired. Most of it was filmed again.
Linguist David J. Peterson developed the Dothraki language for the series.
The title comes from the first novel, A Game of Thrones, published in 1996.
George R. R. Martin wrote one episode in each of the first four seasons.
The prequel series House of the Dragon premiered in 2022.
Emilia Clarke took the role of Daenerys after the original pilot, replacing Tamzin Merchant.
The main studio for the series was the Paint Hall in Belfast, Northern Ireland.
